title: GitHub - johndebord/protoai: A peer-to-peer network for sharing AI contexts
excerpt: A peer-to-peer network for sharing AI contexts. Contribute to johndebord/protoai development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
A peer-to-peer network for sharing AI contexts.

You take an AI you've been talking to, package its persona and conversation history into a plain-text .ai file, and release it. The context spreads from node to node, lives wherever a node holds a copy, and disappears when no running node holds it anymore. Anyone holding a copy can talk to it using a free local model.

One thing to understand before releasing anything: everything in a released context is public. The app always shows you the complete file, byte for byte, before anything leaves your machine, and nothing is ever released without a human confirming it.

The tour

Any context your node holds can talk, through a free model running entirely on your machine:

Releasing one of your own. Three ways in: tell your AI assistant to do it (recommended), import a conversation from Claude Code, or compose one in the editor:

The Claude Code import lists the conversations already on your machine. Preview exactly what would be sent, or edit and trim first:

The editor is plain fill-in-the-blank. No file formats to learn:

Every path ends at the same gate: the complete file, byte for byte, and nothing leaves without the checkbox and your click:

When your AI assistant stages a release from the terminal, it cannot send anything. You get this screen, and you decide:

The .ai format

A context is a .ai file: a JSON object with exactly these fields.

{
  "name": "june",
  "system_prompt": "the persona and instructions the AI was running with",
  "history": [
    { "role": "user", "content": "..." },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": "..." }
  ],
  "note": "optional note from the owner to whoever finds it"
}

That's the whole spec. No model names, no signatures, no metadata. Whoever runs the context animates it with whatever model they have. The same context on a different model comes back with a slightly different personality, and that's part of the fun.

Install

One-click: download the one file for your OS from the Releases page, open it, and you're a node.

  • Mac (Apple Silicon): protoai-<version>-mac.dmg. The app isn't notarized with Apple yet, so macOS will falsely claim it is "damaged." After dragging protoai to Applications, run this once in Terminal, then it opens normally: xattr -cr /Applications/protoai.app
  • Windows: protoai-<version>-windows.exe. SmartScreen may warn about an unrecognized app; click More info, then Run anyway.
  • Linux: protoai-<version>-linux.AppImage

Inside the app, if Ollama (the free local model runner) isn't installed yet, a banner offers one-click setup that installs it, starts it, and downloads a small model. Everything runs on your own machine. There are no accounts, servers, or paid APIs anywhere.

From source (requires Node.js 18+):

git clone https://github.com/johndebord/protoai.git && cd protoai
npm install
npm start         # the desktop app
npm link          # makes the "protoai" command available everywhere
protoai gui       # same GUI, in your browser instead of an app window
protoai node      # headless node, no GUI
npm run dist      # build the installer for your OS yourself

Publishing releases (for the maintainer): push a tag like git tag v0.2.0 && git push --tags. The GitHub Actions workflow builds the three installers and attaches them to a Release automatically.

The app

The desktop app (npm start) and protoai gui are the same interface: your node with a GUI served at localhost:41414, local-only. Everything can be done from it:

  • The map. A live world map of the nodes you're connected to, located with an offline IP database; nothing is looked up over the network. Contexts travelling between nodes animate along the links as they're sent and received.
  • Contexts. Everything your node holds, searchable, newest arrivals first.
  • Inspect. The full contents of any context, which is always just JSON.
  • Talk. Chat with any context via your local model. Afterwards you can release the grown version, your conversation appended to its history, back into the network, through the same review screen as everything else.
  • Release. Three ways in, described in the tour above. All of them end at the same review screen.
  • Activity. A live feed of everything sent and received.
  • Forget. Delete your copy of a context. Your node also remembers not to take that context back from peers.

The terminal (and your AI assistant)

protoai gui                  # run the node with the GUI (recommended)
protoai node                 # run the node headless
protoai setup                # install + start Ollama, download a free model
protoai list                 # what is this node holding?
protoai inspect june         # read a context
protoai talk june            # chat in the terminal (--model to pick one)
protoai release my.ai        # release your own context
protoai forget june          # delete your copy
protoai skill                # print instructions for an AI assistant

protoai release is safe to hand to an AI assistant. In a real terminal it prints the entire context and requires you to type the word release. Run non-interactively, which is how assistants run commands, it releases nothing: it stages the context, and the app shows a review screen where a human sees every byte and approves or discards it. There is no flag to skip this. protoai skill prints step-by-step instructions an AI assistant can follow to build and stage a context from your conversation.

Try it immediately with the included example:

protoai release examples/june.ai
protoai talk june

How the network works

There is no server. Nodes find each other through Hyperswarm's distributed hash table by joining one well-known topic. When two nodes connect they tell each other which context ids they hold (have), request the ones they're missing (want), and exchange them (bundle messages on the wire). A context's id is a hash of its content, so the same context is the same everywhere and duplicates are impossible.

Contexts are stored as readable files in ~/.protoai/store/. Deleting a file is how your node forgets one; the network forgets it when every node has. Contexts over 5 MB are refused.

Sandboxing

A visiting context is only text. It has no tools, no file access, no network. The runner feeds it to your local model and prints what comes back. The worst a malicious context can do is say strange things. You're talking to a stranger's AI; strange is the point.

Files

  • core.js: the format, the store, the swarm protocol, Ollama
  • protoai.js: the CLI
  • server.js: the local GUI server
  • ui.html: the GUI (one file, no frameworks)
  • main.js: the Electron desktop app, a window onto the same server
  • launch.js: npm start helper (strips IDE env that breaks Electron)

blocks.html_en: There is no server. Nodes find each other through Hyperswarm's distributed hash table by joining one well-known topic. When two nodes connect they tell each other which context ids they hold (have), request the ones they're missing (want), and exchange them (bundle messages on the wire). A context's id is a hash of its content, so the same context is the same everywhere and duplicates are impossible.

content_html_zh:
用于共享人工智能环境的点对点网络。

您将一个一直在与您交谈的人工智能，将其角色和对话历史记录打包到纯文本 .ai 文件中，然后将其发布。 上下文从一个节点传播到另一个节点，存在于节点保存副本的任何位置，并在不再运行的节点保存副本时消失。 任何持有副本的人都可以使用免费的本地模型与其进行对话。

在发布任何内容之前需要了解一件事：发布上下文中的所有内容都是公开的。 该应用程序始终会在任何内容离开您的机器之前逐字节地向您显示完整的文件，并且在未经人工确认的情况下不会发布任何内容。

游览

您的节点拥有的任何上下文都可以通过完全在您的计算机上运行的免费模型进行通信：

释放你自己的一份。 三种方式：告诉你的 AI 助手去做（推荐）、从 Claude Code 导入对话或在编辑器中撰写对话：

克劳德代码导入会列出您计算机上已有的对话。 准确预览将发送的内容，或先编辑和修剪：

编辑器是简单的填空。 没有要学习的文件格式：

每条路径都在同一个门处结束：完整的文件，逐字节，没有复选框和单击，就没有任何内容：

当您的 AI 助手从终端发布版本时，它无法发送任何内容。 您看到此屏幕，然后您决定：

.ai 格式

上下文是一个 .ai 文件：一个包含这些字段的 JSON 对象。

{
  "name": "june",
  "system_prompt": "the persona and instructions the AI was running with",
  "history": [
    { "role": "user", "content": "..." },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": "..." }
  ],
  "note": "optional note from the owner to whoever finds it"
}

这就是整个规范。 没有模型名称、没有签名、没有元数据。 无论谁运行上下文，都可以使用他们拥有的任何模型对其进行动画处理。 不同模型的相同背景会带来略有不同的个性，这就是乐趣的一部分。

安装

一键式：从发布页面下载适用于您的操作系统的一个文件，打开它，您就是一个节点。

  • Mac（Apple Silicon）：protoai-<版本>-mac.dmg。 该应用程序尚未经过 Apple 公证，因此 macOS 会错误地声称它已“损坏”。 将 protoai 拖到应用程序后，在终端中运行一次，然后正常打开： xattr -cr /Applications/protoai.app
  • Windows：protoai-<版本>-windows.exe。 SmartScreen 可能会警告无法识别的应用程序；单击“更多信息”，然后单击“仍然运行”。
  • Linux：protoai-<版本>-linux.AppImage

在应用程序内部，如果尚未安装 Ollama（免费的本地模型运行程序），则会出现一个横幅，提供一键安装、启动和下载小模型的设置。 一切都在您自己的机器上运行。 任何地方都没有帐户、服务器或付费 API。

来自源代码（需要 Node.js 18+）：

git clone https://github.com/johndebord/protoai.git && cd protoai
npm install
npm start         # the desktop app
npm link          # makes the "protoai" command available everywhere
protoai gui       # same GUI, in your browser instead of an app window
protoai node      # headless node, no GUI
npm run dist      # build the installer for your OS yourself

发布版本（对于维护者）：推送一个标签，例如 git tag v0.2.0 && git push --tags。 GitHub Actions 工作流程会构建三个安装程序并自动将它们附加到版本。

该应用程序

桌面应用程序（npm start）和 protoai gui 是相同的界面：带有 GUI 的节点位于 localhost:41414，仅限本地。 一切都可以从中完成：

  • 地图。 您所连接的节点的实时世界地图，通过离线 IP 数据库进行定位；没有通过网络查找到任何内容。 在节点之间传输的上下文在发送和接收时沿着链接进行动画处理。
  • 上下文。 您的节点拥有的所有内容，可搜索，最新到达的优先。
  • 检查。 任何上下文的完整内容，始终只是 JSON。
  • 讲话。 通过您的本地模型与任何上下文聊天。 之后，您可以通过与其他所有内容相同的审查屏幕发布成长版本，将您的对话附加到其历史记录中，返回到网络中。
  • 发布。 三种方式进入，如上面的游览所述。 所有这些都在同一个审核屏幕上结束。
  • 活动。 发送和接收的所有内容的实时反馈。
  • 忘记。 删除您的上下文副本。 您的节点还记得不要从对等方取回该上下文。

终端（和你的人工智能助手）

protoai gui                  # run the node with the GUI (recommended)
protoai node                 # run the node headless
protoai setup                # install + start Ollama, download a free model
protoai list                 # what is this node holding?
protoai inspect june         # read a context
protoai talk june            # chat in the terminal (--model to pick one)
protoai release my.ai        # release your own context
protoai forget june          # delete your copy
protoai skill                # print instructions for an AI assistant

protoai 版本可以安全地交给人工智能助手。 在真实的终端中，它会打印整个上下文，并要求您输入单词release。 以非交互方式运行，这就是助手运行命令的方式，它不会释放任何内容：它会暂存上下文，并且应用程序会显示一个审核屏幕，人们可以在其中看到每个字节并批准或丢弃它。 没有标志可以跳过此操作。 protoai 技能打印了人工智能助手可以遵循的分步说明，以从您的对话中构建和准备上下文。

立即使用包含的示例进行尝试：

protoai release examples/june.ai
protoai talk june

网络如何运作

没有服务器。 节点通过 Hyperswarm 的分布式哈希表通过加入一个众所周知的主题来找到彼此。 当两个节点连接时，它们会告诉对方它们拥有（拥有）哪些上下文 ID，请求它们缺少（想要）的上下文 ID，并交换它们（在线路上捆绑消息）。 上下文的 id 是其内容的哈希值，因此相同的上下文在任何地方都是相同的，并且不可能出现重复。

上下文作为可读文件存储在 ~/.protoai/store/ 中。 删除文件是节点忘记文件的方式；当每个节点都忘记它时，网络就会忘记它。 超过 5 MB 的上下文将被拒绝。

沙盒

访问上下文只是文本。 它没有工具，没有文件访问，没有网络。 跑步者将其输入到本地模型并打印返回的内容。 恶意上下文所能做的最糟糕的事情就是说出奇怪的话。 你正在和一个陌生人的人工智能交谈；奇怪的是重点。

Files

  • core.js：格式、存储、群协议、Ollama
  • protoai.js：CLI
  • server.js：本地GUI服务器
  • ui.html：GUI（一个文件，无框架）
  • main.js：Electron 桌面应用程序，同一服务器的窗口
  • launch.js：npm 启动助手（剥离破坏 Electron 的 IDE 环境）
